scenarios.title: An effect opens an Attraction from the Attraction deck onto the battlefield

setup.notes: A's Attraction deck (in the command zone) holds exactly one card, Concession Stand (the variant lit on 2 and 6).

decisions: A casts Deadbeat Attendant, tapping both Swamps.
Both players pass; Deadbeat Attendant resolves and enters.
Its enters trigger (open an Attraction) goes on the stack; both players pass; it resolves.

variants.label: deck_has_attraction
variants.expected: Concession Stand moves from A's Attraction deck to the battlefield under A's control, untapped. A's Attraction deck is empty.

variants.label: deck_empty
variants.expected: The trigger resolves and nothing happens: no Attraction is on the battlefield. Deadbeat Attendant stays on the battlefield.

operation.unclassifiable: The Attraction deck in the command zone is emptied; no fork operation changes a command-zone deck.

scenarios.forge_notes: Needs a registered Attraction deck for player A; an empty deck is the default.

detector.outcome: A card is put onto the battlefield by an effect that opens it from outside the library or hand.
detector.near_miss: An effect of the same API that put nothing onto the battlefield.

scenarios.title: The active player rolls to visit their Attractions as the precombat main phase begins

setup.notes: Concession Stand is the variant lit on 2 and 6. The die rolled is fixed to 1, which lights no number. Complaints Clerk's trigger (whenever you roll a 1) makes the roll visible.

decisions: Both players pass priority in the draw step; the precombat main phase begins.
A, controlling an Attraction, rolls to visit (the die shows 1).
Complaints Clerk's trigger goes on the stack; both players pass; it resolves.

variants.label: controls_attraction
variants.expected: A rolls a die as main1 begins. Complaints Clerk triggers on the roll of 1 and A creates a 1/1 white Clown Robot artifact creature token. Concession Stand does not trigger, so no Food token is created.

variants.label: attraction_controlled_by_opponent
variants.delta: Concession Stand is controlled by B instead of A.
variants.expected: A controls no Attraction, so no die is rolled as main1 begins. Complaints Clerk does not trigger and no token is created.

operation.unclassifiable: The Attraction's controller changes to the opponent; no fork operation changes control.

scenarios.forge_notes: Needs the die result fixed (seeded or forced roll).

detector.outcome: A visit ability is evaluated, which shows that the player who controls that Attraction rolled to visit their Attractions as their precombat main phase began. Forge evaluates a visit trigger only when the roll matches one of the Attraction's lit numbers.
detector.near_miss: Not seen: a player who controls no Attraction rolls no die, and a roll matching no lit number leaves no visit trigger record.

scenarios.title: A visit ability triggers only when the visit roll matches a lit-up number

setup.notes: Concession Stand is the variant lit on 2 and 6. Visit: create a Food token.

decisions: Both players pass priority in the draw step; the precombat main phase begins.
A rolls to visit (the die shows 2).
If Concession Stand's visit ability triggered, both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: roll_2
variants.expected: The roll matches a lit number: the visit ability triggers and A creates a Food token.

variants.label: roll_6
variants.expected: 6 is also lit: the visit ability triggers and A creates a Food token.

operation.unclassifiable: The die roll's result differs; a random result is no fork operation.

variants.label: roll_3
variants.expected: 3 is not lit: the visit ability does not trigger and A creates no Food token.

operation.unclassifiable: The die roll's result differs; a random result is no fork operation.

scenarios.forge_notes: Needs the die result fixed (seeded or forced roll).

detector.outcome: An Attraction's visit ability (a trigger the Visit keyword generates) fires because the roll to visit matched one of its lit numbers.
detector.near_miss: A visit ability evaluated and not fired. Rarely seen: Forge evaluates a visit trigger only for Attractions whose lit numbers match the roll, so a non-matching roll leaves no trigger record.

scenarios.title: An Attraction leaving the battlefield goes to the command zone instead of the graveyard, unless it is exiled

setup.notes: Concession Stand is owned by B.

decisions: A casts Shatter targeting Concession Stand, tapping Mountain and one Plains.

variants.label: destroyed
variants.expected: Concession Stand would go to B's graveyard but B puts it into the command zone (B's junkyard) instead. B's graveyard is empty.

variants.label: exiled
variants.delta: A casts Banishing Light (tapping Mountain and both Plains) instead of Shatter; its enters trigger targets Concession Stand and resolves.
variants.expected: Exile is excepted: Concession Stand is exiled, not put into the command zone. The replacement does not apply.

operation.unclassifiable: A different spell is cast (an exile effect instead of a destroy effect); no fork operation changes what is cast.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge moves the card to the Junkyard zone in GameAction.changeZone; exile is explicitly excepted.

detector.outcome: A move to the graveyard is replaced by a move to another zone.
detector.near_miss: A move to the graveyard that met a replacement effect and was not replaced.
